title: Comparing Financial Reporting Tools Between Dynamics GP and Dynamics Business Central (2024)

chapters.title: Financial reporting in GP and introduction to Business Central
Account schedules overview and built-in templates
Account categories and migration from GP
Account schedule structure, formulas and column layouts
Filtering by dimensions and drilling down into details

features.name: Account Schedules
features.description: Financial reporting tool in Business Central that creates financial statements using account subcategories from general ledger accounts. Business Central comes with eight different account schedules out of the box.
caveats: Requires account categories to be assigned to accounts for proper reporting
Accounts without assigned categories will not be included on account schedules

features.name: Account Categories and Subcategories
features.description: Organizational structure used to categorize general ledger accounts for financial reporting. When migrating from GP using the cloud migration tool, accounts and their assigned categories are moved to Business Central.
caveats: Manual category creation needed for accounts not assigned during migration
Account schedules must be updated after category changes to reflect new accounts

features.name: Account Schedule Row Definitions and Formulas
features.description: Each row in an account schedule is numbered to allow creation of formulas for summing multiple accounts or dividing values. Supports formatting options like bold, italics, and page breaks.

features.name: Account Schedule Column Layouts
features.description: Allows selection of different column layouts and date ranges for account schedules. Amounts automatically update as different date ranges are selected.

features.name: Dimension Filtering for Account Schedules
features.description: Ability to filter account schedules by dimensions to view financial data for specific departments or entities. In the demo, filtering by sales department shows expenses only for that department.

features.name: Drill Down into Account Schedule Details
features.description: Ability to drill down into each amount on an account schedule to see further details and underlying transactions.

features.name: Account Schedule Export to Excel
features.description: Ability to export account schedules to Excel for further analysis and sharing.

features.name: Account Schedule Import and Export Across Companies
features.description: Ability to export account schedules from one company and import them into other companies for reuse.
